segs.pali: 10. Āhuneyyavaggo
segs.zh: 10. 应请品

segs.pali: ‘‘Sattime , bhikkhave, puggalā āhuneyyā…pe… dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. Katame satta? Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo cakkhusmiṃ aniccānupassī viharati aniccasaññī aniccapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno. So āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, paṭhamo puggalo āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo…pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，有七种人应受供养……（中略）……应受供施、应受合掌、是世间无上福田。哪七种呢？诸比丘，有一种人于眼随观无常而住，具无常想，感受无常，持续、恒常、不间断地以心胜解、以慧深入观察。他诸漏已尽，于现法中以证智自作证，具足无漏的心解脱、慧解脱而住。诸比丘，这是第一种人，应受供养……（中略）……是世间无上福田。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo cakkhusmiṃ aniccānupassī viharati aniccasaññī aniccapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno. Tassa apubbaṃ acarimaṃ āsavapariyādānañca hoti jīvitapariyādānañca. Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo puggalo āhuneyyo…pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
segs.zh: “再者，诸比丘，又有一种人于眼随观无常而住，具无常想，感受无常，持续、恒常、不间断地以心胜解、以慧深入观察。他的诸漏尽与命终同时发生。诸比丘，这是第二种人，应受供养……（中略）……是世间无上福田。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo cakkhusmiṃ aniccānupassī viharati aniccasaññī aniccapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno. So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti…pe… upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti…pe… asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti…pe… sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti…pe… uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī. Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sattamo puggalo āhuneyyo…pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. Ime kho, bhikkhave, satta puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’’ti.
segs.zh: “再者，诸比丘，于此有这样一种人：于眼随观无常而住，具足无常想，恒常不断地觉知无常，以心胜解、以慧深察。他藉由五下分结的灭尽，成为中般涅槃者……（中略）……成为生般涅槃者……（中略）……成为无行般涅槃者……（中略）……成为有行般涅槃者……（中略）……成为上流者，趋于阿迦尼吒天。诸比丘，这是第七种人，应受供养、应受供施、应受合掌，是世间无上福田。诸比丘，正是这七种人，应受供养、应受供施、应受合掌，为世间无上福田。”

segs.pali: Sattime , bhikkhave, puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā…pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. Katame satta? Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo cakkhusmiṃ dukkhānupassī viharati…pe… cakkhusmiṃ anattānupassī viharati…pe… cakkhusmiṃ khayānupassī viharati…pe… cakkhusmiṃ vayānupassī viharati…pe… cakkhusmiṃ virāgānupassī viharati…pe… cakkhusmiṃ nirodhānupassī viharati…pe… cakkhusmiṃ paṭinissaggānupassī viharati…pe….
segs.zh: “诸比丘，这七种人是应受供养、应受供施、应受合掌的世间无上福田。哪七种呢？诸比丘，于此，有这样一种人：于眼随观苦而住……（中略）……于眼随观无我而住……（中略）……于眼随观灭尽而住……（中略）……于眼随观坏灭而住……（中略）……于眼随观离贪而住……（中略）……于眼随观灭而住……（中略）……于眼随观舍弃而住……”

segs.pali: Sotasmiṃ…pe… ghānasmiṃ… jivhāya… kāyasmiṃ… manasmiṃ…pe….
segs.zh: “于耳……（中略）……于鼻……于舌……于身……于意……（中略）……”

segs.pali: Rūpesu…pe… saddesu… gandhesu… rasesu… phoṭṭhabbesu … dhammesu …pe….
segs.zh: “于诸色……于诸声……于诸香……于诸味……于诸触……于诸法……”

segs.pali: Cakkhuviññāṇe…pe… sotaviññāṇe… ghānaviññāṇe… jivhāviññāṇe… kāyaviññāṇe… manoviññāṇe…pe….
segs.zh: “于眼识……于耳识……于鼻识……于舌识……于身识……于意识……”

segs.pali: Cakkhusamphasse…pe… sotasamphasse… ghānasamphasse… jivhāsamphasse… kāyasamphasse… manosamphasse…pe….
segs.zh: “于眼触……于耳触……于鼻触……于舌触……于身触……于意触……”

segs.pali: Cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya…pe… sotasamphassajāya vedanāya… ghānasamphassajāya vedanāya… jivhāsamphassajāya vedanāya… kāyasamphassajāya vedanāya… manosamphassajāya vedanāya…pe….
segs.zh: 于眼触所生之受……于耳触所生之受……于鼻触所生之受……于舌触所生之受……于身触所生之受……于意触所生之受……

segs.pali: Rūpasaññāya…pe… saddasaññāya… gandhasaññāya… rasasaññāya… phoṭṭhabbasaññāya… dhammasaññāya…pe….
segs.zh: 于色想……于声想……于香想……于味想……于触想……于法想……

segs.pali: Rūpasañcetanāya…pe… saddasañcetanāya… gandhasañcetanāya… rasasañcetanāya… phoṭṭhabbasañcetanāya… dhammasañcetanāya…pe….
segs.zh: 于色思……于声思……于香思……于味思……于触思……于法思……

segs.pali: Rūpataṇhāya…pe… saddataṇhāya… gandhataṇhāya… rasataṇhāya… phoṭṭhabbataṇhāya… dhammataṇhāya…pe….
segs.zh: 于色渴爱中……于声渴爱中……于香渴爱中……于味渴爱中……于触渴爱中……于法渴爱中……

segs.pali: Rūpavitakke …pe… saddavitakke… gandhavitakke… rasavitakke… phoṭṭhabbavitakke… dhammavitakke…pe….
segs.zh: 于色寻中……于声寻中……于香寻中……于味寻中……于触寻中……于法寻中……

segs.pali: Rūpavicāre…pe… saddavicāre… gandhavicāre… rasavicāre… phoṭṭhabbavicāre… dhammavicāre…pe….
segs.zh: 于色伺中……于声伺中……于香伺中……于味伺中……于触伺中……于法伺中……

segs.pali: ‘‘Pañcakkhandhe …pe… rūpakkhandhe… vedanākkhandhe… saññākkhandhe… saṅkhārakkhandhe… viññāṇakkhandhe aniccānupassī viharati…pe… dukkhānupassī viharati… anattānupassī viharati… khayānupassī viharati… vayānupassī viharati… virāgānupassī viharati… nirodhānupassī viharati… paṭinissaggānupassī viharati…pe… lokassā’’ti.
segs.zh: “于五蕴——于色蕴、受蕴、想蕴、行蕴、识蕴，随观无常而住，随观苦而住，随观无我而住，随观灭尽而住，随观坏灭而住，随观离贪而住，随观灭而住，随观舍弃而住……于世间”

segs.pali: ‘‘Chadvārārammaṇesvettha, viññāṇesu ca phassesu;
segs.zh: “于此六门所缘中，于诸识与诸触；

segs.pali: Vedanāsu ca dvārassa, suttā honti visuṃ aṭṭha.
segs.zh: 于诸受与门，各有八经。

segs.pali: ‘‘Saññā sañcetanā taṇhā, vitakkesu vicāre ca;
segs.zh: “想、思、渴爱，在寻与伺之中；

segs.pali: Gocarassa visuṃ aṭṭha, pañcakkhandhe ca pacceke.
segs.zh: 于行境，各别有八种；于五蕴，亦各各别。

segs.pali: ‘‘Soḷasasvettha mūlesu, aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā;
segs.zh: “于此十六根本，是无常、苦、无我；

segs.pali: Khayā vayā virāgā ca, nirodhā paṭinissaggā.
segs.zh: 由坏灭、消逝、离贪，由灭尽与彻底舍离。

segs.pali: ‘‘Kamaṃ aṭṭhānupassanā, yojetvāna visuṃ visuṃ;
segs.zh: “依次将八种随观，各各分别结合；

segs.pali: Sampiṇḍitesu sabbesu, honti pañca satāni ca;
segs.zh: 综此一切，总集之时，即成五百种。

segs.pali: Aṭṭhavīsati suttāni, āhuneyye ca vaggike’’ .
segs.zh: 二十八经，属应供养品。”

segs.pali: Āhuneyyavaggo dasamo.
segs.zh: 应请品第十。
